install_crypten_package: install the crypten package from source using pip install in the project root directory
extract_version_from_init: extract the __version__ string from crypten/__init__.py using a regex pattern match
read_requirements_file: read requirements.txt and split into a list of install requirements for setuptools
read_readme_for_description: read README.md and use its contents as the long description for the package
run_setuptools_setup: run setuptools.setup with name, version, packages, requirements, and data files for crypten
